pushstate-analytics.why: select() calls the global history.pushState at call time (not a cached reference), so analytics.js's patched wrapper would still fire.

popstate.why: Initial tag comes from URLSearchParams on ?tag= via tagFromLocation, and the popstate listener is added and removed in a useEffect cleanup.

lazy.why: LazyImage uses IntersectionObserver with rootMargin '300px' and disconnects in the effect cleanup on unmount.

active-class.why: The button gets className='active' when f.tag === tag.

escape.why: Titles are rendered as JSX text in figcaption and alt={p.title} is kept on the img.

no-silent-changes.why: The summary calls out the URL-encoding of the tag and the per-image observers replacing the shared one, and states gallery.js and index.html were left unwired.
